results.content: # Title:Hypergraph Neural Network with State Space Models for Node Classification. View a PDF of the paper titled Hypergraph Neural Network with State Space Models for Node Classification, by A. > Abstract:In recent years, graph neural networks (GNNs) have gained significant attention for node classification tasks on graph-structured data. To address these limitations, we propose a hypergraph neural network with a state space model (HGMN). The model integrates role-aware representations into GNNs by combining hypergraph construction with state-space modeling in a principled manner. By exploring two distinct hypergraph construction strategies, degree-based and neighborhood-based, the framework reinforces connectivity among nodes with structural similarity, thereby enriching the learned representations. These results support the claim that explicitly incorporating role-based features within a hypergraph framework offers tangible benefits for node classification tasks. |  | (or  arXiv:2508.06587v2 [cs.LG] for this version) |.
